description: Start a NEW Echosaw analysis job by uploading a local audio, video, image, or document (PDF, TXT, Markdown, PPTX) file from disk. This is an entry point that creates a job and begins processing — it does not fetch or re-download previously analyzed media (use echosaw_download_media for that). Returns a job ID (mediaId) used to track processing and retrieve results.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the media or document file on disk

mediaType.description: One of: video, audio, image, document

name: echosaw_analyze_media
